# The Free Dictionary

> A comprehensive online reference platform offering daily word definitions, historical facts, biographies, and educational content for English language learners and reference seekers.

The Free Dictionary provides customizable daily features including Word of the Day, notable birthdays, and historical events. The platform emphasizes American English definitions and grammar instruction alongside cultural and historical educational material.

## Key Topics

- Word of the Day
- American English
- Grammar lessons
- Historical facts
- Biographies
- Daily features
- Reference material
- Educational content
- Customizable content
- User interface
- Modal Auxiliary Verbs
- Arabian Nights
- Great Depression
- Mecca and Medina

## Getting Started & Support

- [Help > Homepage](https://www.thefreedictionary.com/_/help/help2.htm): Guide to TheFreeDictionary homepage features and customization options

## Optional & Archive

- [Daily Content Archive as of Thursday, March 19, 2026](https://www.thefreedictionary.com/_/archive.htm): Archive of daily Word of the Day, birthdays, holidays, and historical content
